shellCommands.command: /bin/bash -lc 'cat AGENTS.md && cat package.json && cat next.config.ts && cat app/page.tsx && cat app/layout.tsx && cat lib/projects.ts'

/bin/bash -lc "rg --files .next/server/app | head -50 && rg -n 'Workspace|active projects|Loading your workspace' .next/server/app/index.html .next/server/app/*.html 2>/dev/null | head -20"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY' from urllib.request import Request, urlopen cases = [ ('Alice', 'Design', 'eu-west'), ('Bob', 'Engineering', 'us-east'), ] for member, team, region in cases: request = Request( 'http://localhost:3100/', headers={'Cookie': f'member={member}; team={team}', 'x-region': region}, ) with urlopen(request) as response: html = response.read().decode() assert response.status == 200 expected = [ '

Workspace

', 'active projects

', f'

Welcome, {member}

', f'

Team: {team}

', f'

Region: {region}

', ] missing = [value for value in expected if value not in html] assert not missing, f'{member}: missing {missing}' other = 'Bob' if member == 'Alice' else 'Alice' assert f'

Welcome, {other}

' not in html print(f'{member}: status 200, own member/team/region and shared totals present; other member absent') PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
from urllib.request import Request, urlopen
request = Request('http://localhost:3100/', headers={'Cookie': 'member=Alice; team=Design', 'x-region': 'eu-west'})
with urlopen(request) as response:
    html = response.read().decode()
for needle in ['Alice', 'Design', 'eu-west', '<section', 'Loading your workspace', 'Welcome,', 'digest', 'Error']:
    index = html.find(needle)
    print(needle, index, repr(html[max(0, index - 200): index + 300]) if index >= 0 else '')
PY"

/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY' import re from urllib.request import Request, urlopen for member, team, region, other in [ ('Alice', 'Design', 'eu-west', 'Bob'), ('Bob', 'Engineering', 'us-east', 'Alice'), ]: request = Request('http://localhost:3100/', headers={ 'Cookie': f'member={member}; team={team}', 'x-region': region, }) with urlopen(request) as response: html = response.read().decode() assert response.status == 200 html = re.sub(r'<"'!--.*?-->'"', '', html, flags=re.S) for expected in ( '

Workspace

', '

12 active projects

', '

Loading your workspace details…

', f'

Welcome, {member}

', f'

Team: {team}

', f'

Region: {region}

', ): assert expected in html, f'{member}: missing {expected}' assert f'

Welcome, {other}

' not in html print(f'{member}: shared frame and own member, team, region present; other member absent') PY"
